page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 104 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 104 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

The low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.85 GB per core represents a design tradeoff optimized for compute-heavy tasks rather than memory-intensive applications. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. This hardware profile is structurally aligned with workloads such as high-performance computing, batch processing, compute-heavy web serving, and distributed analytics that require high core counts but have modest memory footprints.
